_note: X68000 Phantasie IV art (tools/scripts/x68k_p4_pkh.py, reverse-engineering/x68000/phantasie4/FORMAT.md 6.9). s102: the title (OPEN.PKH, OPENANI.PKH -> title/). s107 (T6.4): the town streets, the building pictures and the Hall (town/, buildings/, hall/), drawn 1:1 as scenes beside IV's text. The screen is P4.X's own 640x400 layout space (_xunpack coordinates; pictures are not scaled), so the remaster's 320x200 layout is drawn at 2x. s108: the outdoor map pictures OT* (outdoor/, by map: _omaps 0x42DA2 names the file, maps 7/11/12 use OT06, 18/19/24 OT16; the close-up draws one at 2x, the overview a 3x3 block), the endings END1-3 (ending/) and the scroll page SCBACK (scroll/). Also s108: the location-map view and the combat field (dungeon/, combat/; _sets_note). s109: the *_AN / *ANI animation sheets (anim/, p4.anim.*; one PNG per PKH sheet) and P4.X's animation tables (picture_animations, tools/scripts/x68k_p4_anim.py); played since s110 at the pass lengths measured in XEiJ (FORMAT.md 6.10).
name: X68000
_palettes_note: pkh: the one palette every PKH carries (FORMAT.md 6.9), in effect for the *.pix art too; the view and field draw their boxes in its colours 0, 14 and 15.
_fonts_note: s135: P4.X's own ANK fonts (tools/scripts/x68k_p4_fonts.py, FORMAT.md 6.12) where the original draws English-sized text on its pictures: the fight's 'Exit' (_dsp_exit: font 0, style 2 = italic) and the Mystic's bubble (_mystic: _font(0, 0, 0, 16)); drawn in pack pixels like the art. Glyphs the font lacks (kanji: the CG ROM's) come from the pack's font. s136: the street banner's town name (_tload: _font(0, 1, 15, 16), style 1 = bold).
_command_panels_note: s136: P4.X's icon menus (_mkicon / _seticon, FORMAT.md 6.9 'Command panel'; tools/scripts/x68k_p4_panels.py): window 34 beside the picture, icon.pix records as p4.icon.N (ui/icons, 32 x 32, masked), labels in font 1 (p4.panel.label); s140 also the profile / Party info icon rows (window 36, 'rows') and the shipwright's YES / NO box (_noyes, 'noyes').

sound_effects._note: s152: P4.X's sound effects (FORMAT.md 'Sound effects'): _vinit reads VDATA whole; _voice(n) (0x35FBC) plays effect n by IOCS _ADPCMOUT (MSM6258 ADPCM) from the sum of lengths 0..n-1 (table 0x4A338), lengths[n] - 1 bytes, rate 1 (4 MHz / 768 = 5208 Hz), pan 3, when sound effects are on (0x789C5). The callers: _noise 0 (its argument is ignored), _bsetr 1 and _sdatk 6 (no caller: never played), _sdbeep 2, _sdnoi 3, _sdwlk 4 / 5 by turns (_wlkflg 0x4A35C: 4 first), _sddam 7, _sdmag 8. moments: Core's P4Sounds names -> the effects they play (a list plays in turn; lists alike share one turn).

title_sequence._note: _openning (P4.X 0x0, FORMAT.md 6.10): music 99 = replay the current song, set to 0 just before: song 0, OPMDRV MML (FORMAT.md 6.11; played as 'tune', s109); a window of 320x216 pixels titled 'Phantasie IV'; 'STARCRAFT Presents' centred at window y 84 while OPENANI.PKH (to page 1) and OPEN.PKH (window 0, 0) load; the picture covers it; 'By Winston Douglas Wood' at window y 200, under the picture; the torches animate (_setanim 27..29, the 'title' scene of picture_animations, played at the pass length measured in XEiJ, s110) [C]. Then _disk(0) opens New Game / Saved Game over it with no timer (manual ch. 1: 'the title screen appears, and icons ... ask New Game or Saved Game'). The load time is [?]: the first step waits for a key. s151: the picture step carries _disk(0)'s panel ('menu': the pack's command_panels 'disk', _diskmenu(0), FORMAT.md 6.10) and waits for its pick (N or an existing save's digit, or a click on its icon); no other key ends it. Canvas (s151) = screen pixels (216, 73)-(722, 420) of the 768 x 512 screen: window 32's title bar (rows 91-111) and its 320x216 area at _cvx(160) = 216, _cvy(64) = 112 (canvas (0, 18) / (0, 39)), window 34 at _cvx(496) = 585, _cvy(48) = 94 with its 21-row bar above (canvas (369, 0), area from y 21) and 136 x 324 + frame and shadow. Before s151 the canvas was the title window alone (320 x 238). Background (s151) = pkh colour 1: _openning starts with _cls(1) = _fbox(1, 0, 0, 768, 512), the grey under both windows on the XEiJ shots (was black before s151). Window 32's bar: seen in XEiJ (s110) [C] the bar is a frame above the window's area, 21 rows (a black line, 18 rows of grey with the title centred, glyph rows 5-13, a grey line, a black line) right over the picture's top row; the credit's 16-dot line is inside the window under the picture (the frame's bottom line after it). The remaster keeps the 21 rows (picture 21 rows under the bar's top: canvas y 39) and draws the texts in its own font on the grey canvas, glyphs centred where the original's are (the bar and frame lines are not drawn).
title_sequence._tune_note: Song 0 (_mus case 1, P4.X 0x35436): tracks 1-5 each get the header 'o4v9q7l16|:256' and a body, compiled by OPMDRV.X and played on OPM channels 0-4 with the P4.SND voices; addresses are P4.X image addresses (file offset 0x40). The OPM runs at the X68000's 4 MHz [~]. The song repeats 256 times; it plays on under New Game / Saved Game (s151: that panel is the splash's last step) and stops when the splash ends.

_sets_note: s108 (T6.4, FORMAT.md 6.9 'Other *.pix', tools/scripts/x68k_p4_pix.py): the raw *.pix sprites, one PNG each (masked pixels transparent), in the shared PKH palette (the dungeon and combat code set none). Location-map view (_idraw, 9 x 9 overhead): p4.dungeon.floor.N (fl.pix, 32x32, bits 0-5), p4.dungeon.north.N (yoko.pix, 48x32, bits 6-10, 31 = none), p4.dungeon.west.N (tate.pix, 16x64, bits 11-13, 7 = none), p4.dungeon.party.N (mn.pix, 32x32: facing 0-3, +4 in water). Combat field (_opn_field / _obj): p4.combat.ground.<field> (the bback.pix record _e_finit loads: ship 0, desert 1, hill 2, forest / grass 3, mist / nether 4; location map 3, or 8 when _etile = 1), p4.combat.obstacle.N (bobj.pix, 48x48, obstacle kind N), p4.combat.missile.N (fly.pix, 32x32; not drawn: the flight animation's timing is [?]), p4.sprite.N (p4mon.pix record N, its 5 frames of 48x48 left to right; monsters = DATM type, persons = race + 84, race 34 -> 81, the elemental 117 + kind). s151: p4.item.N = the item icons, P4.X font 2's glyph 0x20 + N (N = _idat b0, 0-49; tools/scripts/x68k_p4_fonts.py, 32x32, black ink, the rest transparent), drawn on window grey (colour 14) by the item lists (_itemlist, _dvitmlst, _tritmlst; FORMAT.md 6.9 'Item lists'). Placement offsets: FORMAT.md 6.9 (P4DungeonScreen.View3D.cs / .BattleArt.cs).
_scenes_note: Which pictures each IV town screen shows (P4.X _xunpack calls, FORMAT.md 6.9 table): offsets from the scene's top-left in pack pixels. street.N = _tload's TOWN_<town type + 1> (Pendragon 1, Shipwright towns 2, the rest 3); the Guild picture only at the Guild's own menu (the roster, creation, training and magic clear it, _clrtdraw); the Mystic's speech bubble MYSTLK over the top of MYSTIC comes after the reading (the Client draws it with the score: Core P4MysticReading, _mystic 0x6C68); the Hall = HALL_A with HALL_B under it (y + 202); a history page = HALL_A with SC_A..I at (+40, +24) (_hhist: _cvsx(160) + 40, _cvy(52) + 24). The Armory, Trade and Distribute clear the picture. s108: the ending: Pendragon's street with END1 at (0, 134) (_endset: _tload(1), END1 at (160, 154)), then the banquet END2 and the cell END3 alone (_banquet / _arathamus at (160, 32)); a scroll's pages over SCBACK (_use_sc at (160, 12)). The outdoor map is put together by the Client from p4.outdoor.<map>.

dungeon_view_animation._note: P4.X _ianim (0x175BC; FORMAT.md 6.9 'location-map view' and 6.10 'Dungeon _ianim') [C]: called once a pass of the input loops (_mgetc / _mgetc2), it counts 0x43590 and on the pass that takes it past step_after (every 51st) steps each seen cell of the view rows from _iaflag on: a floor in a floor cycle, a north wall in a north cycle, a west wall in a west cycle steps by one in place (wrapping); every seen cell visited counts 0x43594 (never reset), and a floor in random_floor changes to rand(range) + base, then clears the counter, only while that counter is past random_floor.after. A stepped floor is blitted opaque (_fpix), the party redrawn over a stepped centre floor (+4, in water, on water_floors without Levitation), walls masked. timing_ms measured s119 on XEiJ (original X68000 at 10 MHz; three views, two of them in two boots, 117-195 steps each; the dungeon menu waiting, mouse cursor off the picture): a plain pass, then what the step pass adds per cell visited (outside the map 0xFFFF / inside unseen / seen / seen and stepped; row 0's cells row0_less less, a product by 0 [~]) and per draw. The step period = step_after plain passes + one step pass: 328.1 / 356.3 / 538.6 ms measured in maps 1, 5, 9 (s119), 331.9 ms in map 18 (s120, west walls).

timing_ms._west_draw_note: the west wall's draw (_tpix 0x3AE6A, 16 x 64 masked): measured s120 on XEiJ in Fishing Village (map 18, square (19, 8): three seen west walls 2, nothing else steps; mean 7.16 ms, median 7.19, 855 draws; step pass 55.2 ms, step period 331.9 ms over 285 steps).

picture_animations._note: P4.X _setanim / _anima (FORMAT.md 6.10, tools/scripts/x68k_p4_anim.py) [C]: frames = the frame records 0x45764 [sheet x, sheet y, base, range]; records = the animation records 0x46174 (at = offset from the picture's origin, size, frame ids in order, wrapping); scenes = which sheet and records each picture arms (_setanim call sites). _setanim sets a record's count to (rand(range) + base) >> 2 (rand = 1..range) of the frame it shows next, and each _anima call counts it down; the pass that finds 0 copies that frame (width x height from the sheet), sets the count from the frame just shown and steps on, so a frame stays up for count + 1 calls. _anima runs once per pass of the input loops (_mgetc / _mgetc2) and in _mystic's counted loops, with no Vsync or timer, so a pass is CPU-bound and its length differs per loop: measured in XEiJ (original X68000 at 10 MHz, IPL ROM 1.0; s110: GIF recordings, tools/scripts/xeij_anim_timing.py; s117 / s118: every scene by the mean interval between _anima calls, xeij_trace_build.sh) [C] and stored as a scene's pass_ms (every scene has one; streets 1 and 2 timed in Pendragon with its town type poked); the top-level pass_ms (6.1, the building loops' value) is only a fallback for a scene without one. The pass is longer while the X68000 mouse cursor's place changes it (the street: 5.74 ms with the cursor on a door, 6.88 on the picture elsewhere) [C]; the values are with it resting off the picture. doors = _animdoor (town type x 7 + building): the open door, 40 x 80 from the street sheet, shown before a building is entered (picks 0-5 only: null entries are never read), then a busy wait of 3 x 30000 loop passes: hold_ms 790 from the door's copy to the street's clearing (XEiJ) [C]. P4.X's start-up option NTA (_town_anim = 0) turns off the town and building animations and the doors. welcome (s151) = _tload's 'Welcome!' before each street load (every _town entry, a load in town and the ending's _tload(1)): the street window cleared to colour 'back', the text in font 0 italic colour 'colour' centred on 'at'; it stays while TOWN_n.PKH is read and decoded (hold_ms, XEiJ: 282.5 + 854.0 ms), then the picture's copy (cover_ms) covers it [~] (XEiJ's floppy reads are faster than a real drive's).
